name: Multiloca Lite – Multi Locations Inventory Management
author: Techspawn

sections.description:
Multiloca Lite is the free version of the most comprehensive WooCommerce multi-location inventory management solution. Whether you operate multiple warehouses, retail stores, distribution centers, or drop-shipping locations, this plugin empowers you to efficiently track and display stock levels at each location while providing customers with location-based product availability.

Transform your WooCommerce store into a multi-location powerhouse and provide customers with real-time inventory visibility across all your business locations.

🎯 Why Choose Multiloca Lite?

Multi-Location Inventory Made Simple: Effortlessly manage product stock across unlimited physical locations including warehouses, stores, distribution centers, and fulfillment hubs.

Enhanced Customer Experience: Allow customers to view product availability at specific locations and choose their preferred pickup or shipping location during shopping.

Professional Stock Display: Showcase location-based inventory with multiple display styles including tables, lists, cards, and custom layouts.

Seamless Integration: Built specifically for WooCommerce with native compatibility and intuitive admin interface.

✨ Key Features

  • 🏪 Unlimited Locations: Create and manage unlimited business locations with detailed information including addresses, contact details, and operating hours
  • 📦 Location-Based Inventory Tracking: Track individual stock quantities for each product at every location with real-time updates
  • 🎨 Multiple Frontend Display Options: Choose from table, list, card, grid, and custom display styles for location stock information
  • ⚙️ Customer Location Selection: NEW in v1.1.0 – Enable customers to choose their preferred location for order fulfillment
  • 🛒 Order Fulfillment Support: Allow customers to select fulfillment locations during the shopping process
  • 📱 Responsive Design: Mobile-friendly stock displays that work perfectly on all devices
  • 🎛️ Flexible Display Controls: Show/hide location information, customize layouts, and control visibility per product
  • 📊 Admin Dashboard: Centralized location management with bulk editing capabilities
  • 🔧 Custom CSS Support: Add your own styling through the built-in settings panel
  • 📝 Shortcode Support: Display location information anywhere using flexible shortcodes
  • 🏷️ Location Groups: Organize locations into logical groups for better management

🚀 Perfect For These Business Types

  • Multi-Store Retailers: Manage inventory across physical store locations
  • Warehouse Operations: Track stock across multiple distribution centers
  • Drop-Shipping Businesses: Manage supplier locations and stock levels
  • Franchise Operations: Coordinate inventory across franchise locations
  • Regional Distributors: Handle stock across geographic regions
  • Click-and-Collect Services: Enable location-based pickup options

💼 Upgrade to Pro for Advanced Features

Ready for next-level functionality? Multiloca Pro on CodeCanyon includes:

🎯 Advanced Order Management
* Automatic order routing based on customer location
* Smart fulfillment rules and priority systems
* Location-specific shipping methods and rates

🌍 Geolocation Features
* Auto-detect customer location and show nearest stock
* Distance-based stock sorting and recommendations
* Google Maps integration for store locators

💰 Location-Based Pricing
* Set different prices per location
* Location-specific discounts and promotions
* Currency and tax variations by region

👥 Team Management
* Location manager roles and permissions
* Staff access controls per location
* Advanced user management capabilities

📊 Advanced Analytics
* Detailed inventory reports and analytics
* Sales performance by location
* Stock movement and forecasting tools

Get Multiloca Pro →

🌟 Premium Enterprise Features

Multiloca Premium offers enterprise-grade capabilities:

🤖 Automated Fulfillment
* Rule-based automatic location assignment
* Advanced order routing algorithms
* Smart inventory allocation systems

📋 Vendor & Purchase Order Management
* Create and manage vendor relationships
* Generate purchase orders automatically
* Track supplier performance and costs

🔄 Stock Transfer Management
* Initiate transfers between locations
* Track transfer status and history
* Automated rebalancing suggestions

🔗 Third-Party Integrations
* ERP system connections
* Accounting software integration
* Advanced API endpoints

Need Help Getting Started?

  • 📖 Read our Quick Start Guide
  • 💬 Get help in our Support Forum or premium customer can raise ticket at (https://multiloca.co/support)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/multiloca-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products > Locations to create your locations.
  4. Edit products to set stock levels for each location.
  5. Configure display options under Settings > Multiloca Lite.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, Multiloca Lite requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

How many locations can I create?

You can create and manage unlimited locations in both the lite and pro versions.

Can customers choose locations during checkout?

Yes! As of version 1.1.0, customers can select their preferred fulfillment location during the shopping process. This feature helps optimize shipping costs and delivery times.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Multiloca Lite is designed to work with any well-coded WooCommerce-compatible theme. The plugin uses standard WooCommerce hooks and follows WordPress coding standards for maximum compatibility.

Can I display location information on product pages?

Yes, location inventory displays automatically on product pages. You can also use shortcodes to display location information anywhere.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin doesn’t collect any personal customer data beyond what WooCommerce already handles. All data processing follows WordPress and WooCommerce privacy standards.
